app.title: Maker
app.subtitle: Maps and worlds
map.label: Hexagonal grid map. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom and click to select a cell.
hint.controls: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click to select
level.title: Level
level.hint: 0 is the finest level. Each level up is √7 ≈ 2.65 times larger and turns ≈ 19.1°.
selection.title: Selected cell
selection.empty: Click a cell to see its address, its parent and its 7 children.
selection.noChildren: Level 0 is the finest: it has no children.
selection.noParent: This is the top level: it has no parent.
view.title: View
view.showUpper: Show the grid of the level above
view.align: Turn the view with the level (as in the diagram)
legend.title: Legend
legend.note: Digits are the code's, d = (q − 2r) mod 7. The diagram's numbering is only illustrative.
error.core.level-out-of-range: Level out of the allowed range (0 to 20).
error.core.digit-out-of-range: Digit out of the range 0 to 6.
error.core.no-parent-above-max-level: The top level has no parent.
error.core.level-mismatch: The cells are on different levels.
doc.title: Document
doc.name: World name
doc.openHint: The worlds saved in your account (Ctrl+O)
doc.saveHint: Save to the cloud, in your account (Ctrl+S)
doc.importHint: Open an .ekfr file from your device
doc.exportHint: Download the world as an .ekfr file
doc.confirmDiscard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
doc.hint: Save keeps the world in the cloud, in your account. Export downloads an .ekfr file; Import opens one (old .ekfrase files open too).
error.doc.other-app: This file belongs to another Ekfrase app.
file.otherApp: This file belongs to {app}, not the Maker. Open it in {app}?
file.unknownApp: This file comes from an Ekfrase app this version does not know yet ({app}). Reload the page and try again.
file.handoffExpired: The file sent by another app is no longer available. Open it again.
cloud.title: My worlds
cloud.empty: No worlds in the cloud yet. Use Save to keep the open world.
cloud.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" from the cloud? This can't be undone.
cloud.error.rede: No connection to the server. The world is still open here; try again or use Export.
cloud.error.grande: The world is bigger than the server accepts. Use Export to keep the file.
cloud.error.cota: Your cloud space is full. Delete old worlds in My worlds.
cloud.error.tipo: The server didn't recognize the world file.
cloud.error.login: Your session ended. Reload the page and sign in again.
cloud.error.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment or use Export.
mark.title: Mark
mark.inherited: Mark inherited from {address}: an edit applies to every descendant.
mark.hint: The mark is a test edit: it is stored in the document and applies to the cell and all its descendants.
error.doc.duplicate-id: An item with that identifier already exists.
error.doc.not-an-ekfrase-file: This is not an Ekfrase Maker file.
error.doc.missing-manifest: Incomplete file: the manifest is missing.
error.doc.unsupported-format-version: This file comes from a newer Maker. Update the app to open it.
error.doc.missing-document: Incomplete file: the document is missing.
world.title: World
world.noGenerator: This document has no generator (it was created before Phase 3).
world.hint: Every click on Generate creates a new random world. A saved map always opens the same. To repeat a world on purpose, type the seed and press Enter.
terrain.title: Generated terrain
error.gen.unknown-generator: Unknown generator: update Maker to see this map.
mode.label: Mode
mode.exploreHint: See the clean map, without the grid (E toggles)
mode.editHint: Grid, selection with the 7 children and terrain brush (E toggles)
tool.eraser: Eraser: erases the layer of the chosen brush (X)
brush.hint: In Edit mode each brush paints a layer of the grid cells: from afar, whole regions; up close, details. The paint applies to every descendant, and the finest one wins. To move the map while painting: right button or Space + drag.
tool.label: Name places (N)
brush.mountain: Mountain (side by side they form a range; in a block, a bigger mountain)
brush.zoomIn: {name}: zoom in to use (cells of level {level} or smaller)
label.title: Place name
label.name: Name
label.hint: The name shows in the zoom range where it was created and grows as you zoom out.
style.label: Terrain view
style.mapHint: Illustrated map, like fantasy RPG maps: paper, watercolour, ink symbols
style.satelliteHint: Realistic view, like a virtual globe: everything at true size
palette.label: Tools and brushes
entry.description: Draw whole worlds: continents, mountain ranges, forests and seas, from the whole globe down to a city street.
local.aviso: Local mode: without the Ekfrase server, the world is not saved to the cloud. Use Export to keep the .ekfr file.
